summary: V61 follow-up: verified all 3 business-card fixes on /business-card (Platform web). Fix #1 (white PNG bg): ALL 4 corners + center-gap of exported PNG = (255,255,255) pure white. Fix #2 (logo without box): computed styles of front logo confirm background rgba(0,0,0,0), background-image none, border-top 0px, box-shadow none. Fix #3 (static gold glow + shimmer): both #bc-front-web and #bc-back-web have computed box-shadow containing rgba(212,178,106,0.85) 0px 0px 0px 3px + rgba(240,210,130,0.75) 0px 0px 26px 6px + rgba(212,178,106,0.35) 0px 0px 44px 10px; both mirrors contain a shimmer overlay div with linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(255,255,255,0) 30% -> rgba(255,255,255,0.55) 52% -> rgba(255,255,255,0) 74%). Pixel scan of exported PNG (5328x918) found 653 gold-ish pixels confirming the box-shadow was captured. Outer wrappers bc-front-web-outer / bc-back-web-outer both exist with padding 34px and transparent background. Non-regression: bc-share-image produced ONE single PNG containing fronte+retro side-by-side (5328x918 = 2*card + gap at 3x scale); live RN preview still renders on the screen with front-face shimmer visible; bc-save icon is present in the header; bc-side-front/back segmented toggle works. Test credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md used successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing (not part of this fix) console warnings: 'Invalid style property of animationName. Did you mean animationKeyframes?' emitted from styles.flipContainer & styles.shimmerStreak — these fields set animationName which react-native-web wants as animationKeyframes. Not a regression from V61 fixes, but worth cleaning up as it may cause the gold-pulse and shimmer-move CSS animations to not run via the RN StyleSheet path (they still run via the manually-injected .bc-face-web / .bc-shimmer classes and bc-anim-css keyframes if those classes are applied — currently they are not applied to any element after V61 removed bc-face-web/bc-shimmer classes from the mirrors, and the visible RN preview uses styles.flipContainer's animationName which is being rejected). Net effect: the live web preview still shows a static-looking card because both animation paths are broken. This does NOT affect the shared PNG (which is the user's stated priority and is now correct with static gold + shimmer).
